contracts.name: Lifecycle Capability Contract
contracts.required: Identify reusable lifecycle capability first; preserve meaningful company vocabulary; map local stages/statuses to capabilities; add canonical terms only for evidenced gaps.
contracts.prohibited: Assuming one company's exact pipeline vocabulary is universal.
contracts.evidence: Source vocabulary, explicit crosswalk, and representative cases.
contracts.regression: Two companies with different stage vocabularies must preserve their semantics while binding to the same reusable capability model.

contracts.name: Identity Match != Data-Sharing Authority
contracts.required: Identity match, tenant boundary, consent, purpose and sharing authority remain separate checks.
contracts.prohibited: Merging, disclosing, or reusing all associated data solely because two records represent the same person or company.
contracts.evidence: Identity evidence plus explicit purpose, scope, and sharing authorization evidence.
contracts.regression: Matched identities across separated scopes must remain data-separated absent authority.

contracts.name: Business Event Identity != Transport Attempt
contracts.required: Stable business-event/idempotency key; separate retry/transport-attempt identity; last processed state; safe replay behavior.
contracts.prohibited: Treating duplicate webhook, API, or queue attempts as new business events.
contracts.evidence: Business-event identity, retry history, idempotency behavior, and observed downstream side-effect count.
